name: SULA Eligibility Calculator
description: Configurable block providing a simple AJAX-based SULA (Subsidized Usage Limit Applies) student-loan eligibility calculator.
project_description:
The SULA Eligibility Calculator module creates two blocks (Clock and Credit) that display AJAX-based responsive eligibility calculators based upon configurable academic year length variables.

 Version 2.x 
 The latest release updates the HTML form structure with Bootstrap 5 classes. The Bootstrap theme is no longer required by composer but a Bootstrap 5 based theme is necessary for some features.
